name: Datadog error monitor
description: Poll Datadog logs for new or spiking errors on a schedule, investigate root causes in your codebase, and post a Slack summary with optional PR fixes.

datadog.message: Used to query logs for errors and spikes.

slack.message: Used to post investigation summaries to a configured channel.

exampleImplementation:
Trigger: cron, every 15 minutes by default
Required secrets: DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN

1. Query Datadog logs using a configured filter (e.g. service:api status:error).
2. Match log events against a regex-based error pattern library stored in a state file.
3. Track hit counts per pattern; detect spikes (count > 3x rolling baseline).
4. When new or spiking errors are found, start an investigation conversation.
5. The agent categorizes unknown errors into named patterns, investigates root causes in the configured codebases, creates a PR if confident, and posts a Slack summary.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to poll Datadog for new or spiking errors.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Timezone the schedule is interpreted in.

datadogQuery.label: Datadog log query
datadogQuery.help: The Datadog log filter that runs every poll. Develop and test it in the Datadog Logs Explorer first.

datadogSite.label: Datadog site
datadogSite.help: Your Datadog site. Find it at Organization Settings -> Site in Datadog.

slackChannelId.label: Slack channel ID
slackChannelId.help: The Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123456789) where investigation summaries are posted. The bot must be in the channel.

repoConfigs.label: Monitored repositories
repoConfigs.help: One repository per line as path|host|remote, where host is github, gitlab, or bitbucket. These must already be cloned on the machine running OpenHands. Leave empty to investigate without code access.

maxUnknownLogs.label: Max unknown logs per run
maxUnknownLogs.help: Maximum uncategorized log samples sent to the investigation agent per run.

examplesPerPattern.label: Examples per pattern
examplesPerPattern.help: How many example logs to keep per error pattern in the state file.

spikeMultiplier.label: Spike threshold
spikeMultiplier.help: Alert when a pattern count exceeds this multiple of the rolling 3-run average.

setup.message: This deployment cannot run the scheduled error monitor directly. Set it up in this conversation instead: confirm the Datadog query, site, Slack channel, monitored repositories, and polling schedule, then create the automation.
